title: Sponsorship (DRAFT)
description: A commitment to support a specific tree for a term, carrying an obligation to report on it (SPON-001). Distinct from a donation, which promises nothing in return. DRAFT — not approved.

treeId.description: SPON-002: the tree must be sponsorable — on land with an approved boundary and an established authority to commit it.

sponsorPartyId.description: Set if the sponsor is a known party. A one-off card sponsor may have no party record.

sponsorDisplayName.description: How the sponsor wishes to be shown, if at all. Null means anonymous.

sponsorEmail.description: Required for a sponsorship, since the reporting obligation cannot be met without a way to reach them. Optional for a pure donation.

amount.description: Reuses the APPROVED money schema unchanged: integer minor units, ISO-4217 currency (ADR-027).

reportingIntervalDays.description: How often an observation of this tree is promised. DELIBERATELY has no default: what is promised to a sponsor is a policy decision with legal weight (open question 3). If this is null, no reporting frequency has been promised and none should be implied in any sponsor-facing copy.

status.description: Cannot be 'active' without a succeeded payment, enforced by a database trigger (SPON-003). A refund or chargeback must move it out of 'active'.

isDonation.description: True for a gift with nothing promised in return. Donations and sponsorships have different tax treatment and different obligations, so they are distinguished rather than conflated.
